description: Get one season of a TV show (by show id + season number): overview and the episode list with air dates, runtimes and TMDB vote averages (per-episode `vote_average`, TMDB's own 0-10 user score — not the IMDb/RT/Metacritic scores get_movie/get_tv return as `ratings`, which are whole-show only; this tool makes no OMDb call, and TMDB's season payload carries no per-episode IMDb ids either, so call get_tv_episode when you need one episode's `imdb_id` for get_ratings), capped at 50 episodes (`episode_count` reports the true total). Season 0 is usually specials, which can run to hundreds of bonus clips on a long-running show. Use get_tv with expand_episodes=true instead if you need every season's episodes in one call. Get the show id from search_tv.
name: get_tv_season

vote_average.description: TMDB's own 0-10 user score. A different audience and scale from the IMDb/RT/Metacritic scores get_movie/get_tv return as `ratings` — don't compare, average or substitute across the two.

title: Get TV season
